assets.title: Falling Dollar Bills — Transparent Overlay
assets.description: Pre-keyed US dollar bills flutter through a transparent 4K frame, ready to layer directly over another shot.

source.creator: GreenCardShow
source.acquisition_notes: Downloaded from the asset page as a 4K MP4. The original dark-navy-plate MP4 is preserved beside this reusable transparent derivative.

annotation.meaning: A shower of dollar bills signals money, profit, abundance, a financial win, or deliberately excessive celebration.
use_cases: Celebrating revenue, a sale, funding, or a financial milestone
Adding an exaggerated making-it-rain reaction over another shot
Visualizing money entering a scene or fluttering down after a cash burst
annotation.template_structure: Place the transparent clip on a visual lane above the underlying shot, then trim, scale, and position the bills. No per-project chroma key is required.
annotation.cultural_context: A utility motion-graphics overlay rather than a fixed meme template. Falling US-dollar imagery commonly reads as making it rain, sudden wealth, profit, or a comic financial reward depending on the surrounding edit.
avoid_when: A currency other than US dollars is required
The imagery could imply a guaranteed financial result or trivialize financial hardship
The retained fine printed details do not read cleanly against the intended background
